title: User successfully resets password with valid link
steps: User requests password reset for registered email address
User receives email with reset link
User clicks on reset link within 1 hour
User enters new valid password
User submits the password reset form
expected_result: Password is successfully updated and user can log in with the new password

title: User can log in immediately after password reset
steps: Complete password reset successfully using valid link
Navigate to login page
Enter email and new password
Submit login form
expected_result: User is successfully logged in with the new password

title: Reset link expires after exactly 1 hour
steps: User requests password reset
User receives email with reset link
Wait exactly 1 hour from link generation
User clicks on the reset link
User attempts to submit new password
expected_result: Link is rejected as expired and password is not reset

title: Reset link works at 59 minutes after generation
steps: User requests password reset
User receives email with reset link
Wait 59 minutes from link generation
User clicks on the reset link
User enters new valid password and submits

title: Reset link cannot be used twice
steps: User requests password reset
User clicks reset link and successfully resets password
User attempts to use the same reset link again
User tries to submit a new password
expected_result: Link is rejected as already used and password reset is not allowed

title: Expired reset link shows appropriate error message
steps: User requests password reset
Wait more than 1 hour
User clicks on the expired reset link
expected_result: User sees error message indicating link has expired and is prompted to request a new reset link

title: Invalid or malformed reset link is rejected
steps: User navigates to password reset page with invalid/random token in URL
User attempts to submit new password
expected_result: System rejects the invalid token and displays error message

title: Password reset requested for unregistered email
steps: User enters unregistered email address in password reset form
User submits the request
expected_result: System responds with generic message (without revealing if email exists) and no reset email is sent

title: New reset link invalidates previous unused link
steps: User requests password reset and receives first link
Before using first link, user requests another password reset
User receives second reset link
User attempts to use the first reset link
expected_result: First link is invalidated and rejected; only the most recent link works

title: User cannot reset password for another user's account
steps: User A requests password reset for their email
User B intercepts or obtains User A's reset link
User B clicks the reset link
User B attempts to set a new password
expected_result: Password is reset for User A's account only; User B gains no access to User A's account without knowing the new password

title: Reset link is tied to specific user account
steps: User requests password reset for email account@example.com
User receives reset link with embedded token
Attempt to modify token or URL parameters to target different user
Submit password reset
expected_result: System rejects modified token and does not reset password for any account

title: Reset link at exact moment of expiration boundary
steps: User requests password reset with precise timestamp tracking
User clicks link at exact 3600 second mark (1 hour)
User attempts to submit new password
expected_result: System consistently applies expiration logic (either accepts if <60 min or rejects if >=60 min based on implementation)
